mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch — onlyLzApp checks msg.sender == dcntEth, but _from/_to decoded from _payload are attacker-controlled (no cross-chain identity verification)
missing invariant enforcement — no validation that _from/_to/msgType in _payload correspond to the actual cross-chain sender/locked funds
wrong lifecycle / stale accounting — WETH reserve fallback dcntEth.transfer(_to,_amount) never adjusts balanceOf LP mapping, accounting drift
external-call failure / DoS — weth.withdraw + payable(_to).transfer reverts if _to rejects ETH
value exceeds bound — executor.execute(_from,_to,deliverEth,_amount,callPayload) with attacker-supplied callPayload and _from; no validation
victim accounting direction — weth.approve(executor,_amount) not reset after execute
hook caller/timing — onOFTReceived acts on _payload in same call, no reentrancy guard, executor.execute external

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: _from, _to, msgType, deliverEth, callPayload inside _payload are decoded verbatim from the cross-chain message with no on-chain verification that they match the actual cross-chain originator or intended recipient. Any actor who can craft a LayerZero OFT message (or controls the source-chain router producing the payload) can set _to to an arbitrary address and, in MT_ETH_TRANSFER_WITH_PAYLOAD, supply arbitrary callPayload to executor.execute with the router's full WETH approval.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: An attacker who controls the source-chain DecentEthRouter (or exploits destinationBridges misconfig) sends a crafted _payload: msgType=MT_ETH_TRANSFER_WITH_PAYLOAD, _from=attacker, _to=attacker, deliverEth=true, callPayload=arbitrary.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Attacker controls/compromises the source-chain router in destinationBridges, or submits via a permissive LZ path. 2. onOFTReceived called by dcntEth (onlyLzApp satisfied). 3. _payload decoded: _to=attacker, callPayload=malicious. 4. weth.approve(executor, _amount). 5. executor.execute(_from=attacker, _to=attacker, deliverEth, _amount, callPayload). 6. Executor forwards ETH/WETH to attacker or executes attacker's call with the approved amount.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Liquidity providers / protocol treasury — WETH reserves drained by attacker-directed executor call.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker gains ETH/WETH equal to _amount directed to arbitrary _to or extracted via callPayload.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Payload fields attacker-controlled, executor call is a real external call with real WETH approval, no downstream guard rebuts. Highest-severity mechanism.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: WETH reserve fallback (weth.balanceOf(this) < _amount -> dcntEth.transfer(_to,_amount)) bypasses execution but also bypasses any balanceOf LP accounting update. balanceOf is credited in addLiquidity and debited in removeLiquidity, but onOFTReceived never adjusts it — over many fallback messages dcntEth is transferred out without reducing any LP share, inflating LP claims relative to WETH reserves.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Systemic accounting invariant violation; any cross-chain transfer arriving when WETH reserves are insufficient triggers the fallback.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Transfers arrive while weth.balanceOf(this) < _amount. 2. fallback dcntEth.transfer(_to,_amount). 3. No LP balanceOf debited. 4. LPs later removeLiquidity against the same balanceOf, but dcntEth supply is inflated, causing insolvency for later redeemers.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Later LPs/redeemers who find insufficient WETH/dcntEth backing.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Recipients of fallback dcntEth; early redeemers.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Different accounting variable (balanceOf vs dcntEth supply vs WETH reserves) and victim class (LPs). Source evidence of missing accounting update.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: weth.approve(executor, _amount) is called unconditionally before executor.execute and never reset; leftover approval persists if execute uses less than _amount.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: If executor is misconfigured/compromised, accumulated allowance could be drained.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Multiple MT_ETH_TRANSFER_WITH_PAYLOAD messages arrive. 2. Each weth.approve(executor, _amount). 3. If execute fails/partially consumes, approval lingers until next message.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol WETH reserves if executor later exploited.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Source-backed (approve not reset); authorization state separate from payload-spoofing; NEEDS_HARNESS for partial-consumption.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Stale/excess WETH approval persisting after executor.execute
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: weth.approve(executor,_amount) with no subsequent reset; executor.execute internal behavior out of scope.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does execute always consume exactly _amount or can it consume less, leaving residual allowance exploitable?

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: LP accounting divergence from dcntEth fallback transfers
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: dcntEth.transfer(_to,_amount) with no balanceOf adjustment; removeLiquidity relies on balanceOf+dcntEth.burn.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: How quickly dcntEth-supply inflating vs WETH reserves causes LP redemption failures; rebalancing outside this file?

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: onlyLzApp access-control bypass — direct external call
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: onlyLzApp requires msg.sender == address(dcntEth) and reverts otherwise; a direct external call from a non-dcntEth address cannot pass.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Guard enforced; attacker must route through dcntEth (LayerZero OFT).

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: ETH delivery DoS via reverting _to contract
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: Valid DoS for the MT_ETH_TRANSFER+deliverEth branch but no permanent loss — the call reverts and the bridge message fails; LZ retry semantics apply. Medium-severity DoS, not fully rejected.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Loss not permanent (retry); attacker gains nothing except denying the victim delivery.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: ETH/WETH equal to bridged _amount directed to attacker _to, or extracted via arbitrary callPayload through executor.execute.
impact_direction.attacker_preserves: No local funds spent beyond source-chain gas.
impact_direction.victim_loses: LPs lose WETH reserves drained by attacker-directed executor call; bridge users lose bridged ETH/WETH if delivered to wrong recipient.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain value/authorization: onOFTReceived must deliver funds only to the legitimate originator's intended recipient; _to and callPayload decoded from attacker-controllable payload with no on-chain identity binding.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Drains real WETH reserves; permissionless (requires only a valid LZ OFT message from source, no privileged destination role); scales with reserves.

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: LP accounting divergence + executor approval residual unresolved; DoS via reverting _to noted (leans_on_unproven_guard)
